Table "Affiliated_With" {
  "Physician" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "Department" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "PrimaryAffiliation" BOOLEAN [not null]
}

Table "Appointment" {
  "AppointmentID" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "Patient" INTEGER [not null]
  "PrepNurse" INTEGER
  "Physician" INTEGER [not null]
  "Start" TIMESTAMP [not null]
  "End" TIMESTAMP [not null]
  "ExaminationRoom" TEXT [not null]
}

Table "Block" {
  "BlockFloor" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "BlockCode" INTEGER [pk, not null]
}

Table "Department" {
  "DepartmentID" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "Name" TEXT [not null]
  "Head" INTEGER [not null]
}

Table "Medication" {
  "Code" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "Name" TEXT [not null]
  "Brand" TEXT [not null]
  "Description" TEXT [not null]
}

Table "Nurse" {
  "EmployeeID" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "Name" TEXT [not null]
  "Position" TEXT [not null]
  "Registered" BOOLEAN [not null]
  "SSN" INTEGER [not null]
}

Table "On_Call" {
  "Nurse" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "BlockFloor" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "BlockCode" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "OnCallStart" TIMESTAMP [pk, not null]
  "OnCallEnd" TIMESTAMP [pk, not null]
}

Table "Patient" {
  "SSN" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "Name" TEXT [not null]
  "Address" TEXT [not null]
  "Phone" TEXT [not null]
  "InsuranceID" INTEGER [not null]
  "PCP" INTEGER [not null]
}

Table "Physician" {
  "EmployeeID" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "Name" TEXT [not null]
  "Position" TEXT [not null]
  "SSN" INTEGER [not null]
}

Table "Prescribes" {
  "Physician" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "Patient" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "Medication" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "Date" TIMESTAMP [pk, not null]
  "Appointment" INTEGER
  "Dose" TEXT [not null]
}

Table "Procedures" {
  "Code" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "Name" TEXT [not null]
  "Cost" REAL [not null]
}

Table "Room" {
  "RoomNumber" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "RoomType" TEXT [not null]
  "BlockFloor" INTEGER [not null]
  "BlockCode" INTEGER [not null]
  "Unavailable" BOOLEAN [not null]
}

Table "Stay" {
  "StayID" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "Patient" INTEGER [not null]
  "Room" INTEGER [not null]
  "StayStart" TIMESTAMP [not null]
  "StayEnd" TIMESTAMP [not null]
}

Table "Trained_In" {
  "Physician" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "Treatment" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "CertificationDate" TIMESTAMP [not null]
  "CertificationExpires" TIMESTAMP [not null]
}

Table "Undergoes" {
  "Patient" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "Procedures" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "Stay" INTEGER [pk, not null]
  "DateUndergoes" TIMESTAMP [pk, not null]
  "Physician" INTEGER [not null]
  "AssistingNurse" INTEGER
}
